basics.name: Dwight Doane
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer — Elm && Scala
basics.summary: Software engineer with over a decade of experience shipping quality features and building high-performance teams. Works across the stack in Elm and Scala, and specializes in functional programming: leading rewrites, setting standards, and bringing React engineers along for the ride. Builds and open sources developer tooling for the Elm and ReScript ecosystems.

work.summary: Full-stack product engineer on Avetta's supplier compliance platform, shipping features across a large production Elm frontend and Scala (http4s/Tapir and Play/MongoDB) backend services.
highlights: Shipped creator filtering end to end for the Worksite Safety product: refined the epic into per-service tickets, then implemented all of them solo — Elm filter pickers across four list and calendar views, a Scala 3 http4s/Tapir aggregation service, and the Play/MongoDB persistence layer behind it

Built the formula builder UI for the forms configuration tool, letting configuration engineers author, save, and live-test scoring calculations — cross-category questions, repeatable categories, function library — without engineering involvement

Delivered review-chain management for client admins: site-specific settings pages, clear-all and revert-to-default flows, and safe-deletion UX with server-driven delete permissions and 409 conflict handling
Shipped membership and connection-lifecycle features in the Connect product: renewal-date visibility for clients, connection removal and reconnect flows, and search and filtering on connections pages
Raised the team's code review bar with 419 review comments across 188 PRs, and distilled the org's ~3,400-comment PR review history into living Elm and Scala style guides the team reviews against
Built internal dev tooling, including a runtime Elm view inspector that maps any rendered DOM element back to its source function and line, with a component-tree overlay and lazy-render diagnostics

work.summary: Rewrote CareRev's React-based Facility app as a modern Elm application, on a platform that helps hospitals staff qualified nurses and gives nurses control of their careers.
highlights: Re-architected the start of CareRev's React to Elm rewrite
Shipped high-impact features and services like Smart Rates to high-profile clients, saving them time and money
Mentored junior engineers and trained senior engineers on pure functional concepts
Onboarded engineers of every skill level into an Elm codebase, and set the code practices and standards for Elm development
Built codegen tooling to automate tedious work like Amplitude tracking and tracking-plan updates
Implemented a design system in TailwindCSS with designers, and set up Storybook to visualize it alongside reusable UI
Conducted hiring interviews and authored the code challenges used to vet candidates

work.summary: Rebuilt Halogen and integrated it into Triller's platform after the acquisition, adding live streaming and a web app to their suite of tools.
highlights: Built the scheduled-stream and livestreaming tools used by artists like Jennifer Lopez and DJ Khaled to entertain thousands of fans
Powered the Verzuz battle series, including realtime audience voting during broadcasts
Reverse engineered web applications to bridge Halogen with Triller's existing platform

work.summary: Built Halogen, a live streaming platform for artists and creatives, using Elm, JavaScript, and Web Components.
highlights: Grew Halogen past 120k lines of Elm; the platform was acquired by Triller
Led the upgrade from Elm 0.18 to 0.19 and the migration from BEM-style CSS to TailwindCSS
Onboarded and trained React engineers in Elm and functional programming
Shipped tipping, gifting, chat, and live and prerecorded playback features
Applied modern responsive design practices to support both mobile and desktop viewers
Delivered robust features in short sprints with engineers, designers, and stakeholders, using agile practices to absorb changing requirements and shortened deadlines

work.summary: Helped rewrite an aging PHP application using React and Redux with middleware (redux-observable, redux-saga).
highlights: Learned to structure a large React/Redux application
Picked up the fundamentals of observables with RxJS and honed functional programming skills

work.summary: Taught and supported students across HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, responsive design, Heroku, Git, user authentication, Laravel, React.js, MySQL, and MongoDB. Graded homework and provided in-class and virtual assistance.
highlights: Gave extracurricular lectures on topics students needed but the curriculum skipped: ES6 features, functional programming techniques, and Git fundamentals
Discovered a lasting passion for education and mentoring

work.summary: Set up test automation and load tested APIs, from unit testing React components to end-to-end coverage of user flows.
Built frontend applications with designers, DBAs, and stakeholders, including gogreenback.com.
highlights: Built gogreenback's web app in Angular.js, plus the webviews used by its iOS and Android apps
Built an early company website in Backbone.js and a client dashboard in Node.js and Angular.js

projects.name: elm-peek
projects.summary: Browser extension that brings code navigation to Elm on GitHub, which GitHub's own stack-graphs don't cover. Hover an identifier for its definition and dependents, and get warned when a case expression silently swallows a variant the pull request just added.

projects.name: resq
projects.summary: A jq-style CLI for querying and editing ReScript source, written in Rust and aimed at AI agents and scripts rather than editors: token-efficient structured reads and validated writes that leave the file byte-identical on failure. Ported from elmq.

projects.name: elm-view-name-injector
projects.summary: Post-compile transform that tags each Elm view function's rendered element with the function that produced it, giving Elm the DevTools-style component names it otherwise lacks. No source changes, no wrapper nodes, no runtime library.

projects.name: elm-browser
projects.summary: Fork of elm/browser that adds state-change highlighting to the time-travel debugger, flashing changed fields and striping their ancestors so you can see what changed instead of re-reading the whole model tree.

projects.name: pr-digest
projects.summary: CLI and macOS menu bar plugin that surfaces the open pull requests actually waiting on you, with a badge when something is new since you last looked.

publications.name: Elm for React Devs
publications.summary: Videos and written content helping React developers transition to Elm and a functional programming ecosystem.
